hero.headline: The Policy-Gated Multimodal Executive
hero.subheadline: Combining high-velocity multimodal execution with deterministic governance. Saphira processes complex context, dispatches execution graphs, and operates under real-time equilibrium gates.

pillars.title: Executive Planning (Saphira L2)
pillars.description: Ingests text, voice, code, and documents in one thread to synthesize actionable task graphs without direct side-effect access.

pillars.title: Deterministic Safety (Nova L1)
pillars.description: A non-bypassable governance substrate enforcing real-time approval gates, credential barriers, and financial risk limits.

pillars.title: Isolated Workers (L3 Engine)
pillars.description: Purpose-built execution agents dedicated to code compilation, repository mutation, and system integrations.
